messages.author: c5cad94bd6b8a117
messages.subject: database connection from shiny-server problem
parts:
I have a shiny app that extracts data from a database. I installed RODBC, tested the connection to the database and it is fine (I followed this guide: http://www.freetds.org/userguide/confirminstall.htm). Besides, if I execute the application from RStudio or console everything is ok. However, if I deploy the app to the shiny-server, the app cannot open the connection.


Do I have to configure something else in shiny-server?


Thanks in advance for your help,

Blanca

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: database connection from shiny-server problem
parts:
Blanca,

This is most likely an issue with environment variables. Check your environment with RStudio. Any variable that is set for RODBC should be set such that it is available to user who is running the application on Shiny Server (this is by default "shiny" user).

Fereshteh
